items.summary_en: The Municipality of Santiago officially brought back the historic noon cannon firing at Cerro Santa Lucia. items.raw_excerpt: PORTLAND (WGME) -- Mainers celebrated Indigenous Peoples’ Day for the first time on Monday. Lawmakers renamed the holiday that used to honored Christopher Columbus because of the atrocities he and other European explorers committed. On Monday, the Maine Historical Society in Portland invited people to learn about some of the first people in Maine -- the Wabanaki. In addition to their drumming and singing, people who attended were able to tour a museum exhibit called "Holding up the Sky.
items.summary_en: Mainers celebrated Indigenous Peoples' Day in Portland. The Maine Historical Society held an exhibit called 'Holding up the Sky' about the Wabanaki people. Visitors could tour the exhibit and learn about the first people in Maine through drumming and singing.
